# References · Mark II · Silicon

> From switching circuits to instruction sets, pipelines and emulators.

13 works · difficulty: ★☆☆ accessible · ★★☆ technical · ★★★ research-grade  
Read with the [three-pass method](../../docs/papers.md#how-to-read-a-paper). Every link is a Google Scholar search for the exact title. [Master index →](../../docs/papers.md)

## Start here

#### ★☆☆ The Elements of Computing Systems (2nd ed.)

Nisan & Schocken · 2021 · *MIT Press* · book · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22The%20Elements%20of%20Computing%20Systems%20%282nd%20ed.%29%22)

- **Why:** NAND to CPU, one project at a time.
- **Read:** Ch. 1–5.

#### ★☆☆ Digital Design and Computer Architecture: RISC-V Edition

Harris & Harris · 2021 · *Morgan Kaufmann* · book · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Digital%20Design%20and%20Computer%20Architecture%3A%20RISC-V%20Edition%22)

- **Why:** The RISC-V ISA and microarchitecture, with HDL.
- **Read:** Ch. 6–7.

#### ★★☆ The RISC-V Instruction Set Manual, Volume I: Unprivileged ISA

RISC-V International · 2019 · *Specification* · spec · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22The%20RISC-V%20Instruction%20Set%20Manual%2C%20Volume%20I%3A%20Unprivileged%20ISA%22)

- **Why:** The ground truth your emulator must match.
- **Read:** The RV32I chapter.

## Landmarks

#### ★★☆ A symbolic analysis of relay and switching circuits

Claude Shannon · 1938 · *Transactions of the AIEE* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22A%20symbolic%20analysis%20of%20relay%20and%20switching%20circuits%22)

- **Why:** Boolean algebra meets circuits: the birth of digital logic design, from a master's thesis.
- **Read:** The first sections.

#### ★☆☆ Cramming more components onto integrated circuits

Gordon Moore · 1965 · *Electronics* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Cramming%20more%20components%20onto%20integrated%20circuits%22)

- **Why:** Moore's law, in its original form.
- **Read:** All of it (4 pages).

#### ★☆☆ The case for the reduced instruction set computer

Patterson & Ditzel · 1980 · *ACM SIGARCH Computer Architecture News* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22The%20case%20for%20the%20reduced%20instruction%20set%20computer%22)

- **Why:** The RISC manifesto: simple instructions and fast pipelines.
- **Read:** All of it.

#### ★★★ An efficient algorithm for exploiting multiple arithmetic units

Robert Tomasulo · 1967 · *IBM Journal of Research and Development* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22An%20efficient%20algorithm%20for%20exploiting%20multiple%20arithmetic%20units%22)

- **Why:** Out-of-order execution with register renaming, 1967. Still the core of every big CPU.
- **Read:** All of it, after Harris & Harris ch. 7.

#### ★★☆ A study of branch prediction strategies

James E. Smith · 1981 · *ISCA* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22A%20study%20of%20branch%20prediction%20strategies%22)

- **Why:** The branch-prediction study that started the field.
- **Read:** The strategies and results.

## Go deeper

#### ★★☆ Design of the RISC-V Instruction Set Architecture

Andrew Waterman · 2016 · *PhD thesis, UC Berkeley* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Design%20of%20the%20RISC-V%20Instruction%20Set%20Architecture%22)

- **Why:** Why RISC-V is designed the way it is (the immediate scrambling, x0, compressed instructions), from its designer.
- **Read:** Ch. 2–4.

#### ★★☆ QEMU, a fast and portable dynamic translator

Fabrice Bellard · 2005 · *USENIX ATC* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22QEMU%2C%20a%20fast%20and%20portable%20dynamic%20translator%22)

- **Why:** How QEMU translates guest code dynamically: the step beyond your interpreter.
- **Read:** All of it.

#### ★★★ The structure and performance of efficient interpreters

Ertl & Gregg · 2003 · *Journal of Instruction-Level Parallelism* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22The%20structure%20and%20performance%20of%20efficient%20interpreters%22)

- **Why:** Why interpreter dispatch costs what it does, and how to fix it.
- **Read:** All of it.

#### ★☆☆ A new golden age for computer architecture

Hennessy & Patterson · 2019 · *Communications of the ACM* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22A%20new%20golden%20age%20for%20computer%20architecture%22)

- **Why:** The Turing lecture: domain-specific architectures and the end of Dennard scaling.
- **Read:** All of it.
